name: Combat Competency
body:
School transmutation; Level antipaladin 1, bloodrager 1, cleric/oracle 1, magus 1, paladin 1, ranger 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

You grant the creature greater insight into combat.

They gain a +1 competence bonus to their base attack bonus. If this would grant the target more iterative attacks, they gain the extra iterative attack. This cannot grant more iterative attacks after +20. This stacks with competence bonus to your attack rolls.
